title: Fork setup and rebrand to Faqih
body: Rebrand to Faqih (`APP_NAME`), payments behind a flag and off by default, Arabic fonts (Amiri Quran, Noto Naskh Arabic), `ArabicText`, local dev login, ESLint 10.

title: Content model and import pipeline
body: Courses with slug, path, language and age range; `reviewStatus` on lessons; `source_texts` and `surahs` tables. `content:import` from alquran.cloud, hadith-api and Hisn al-Muslim. The full Quran (114 surahs, 6,236 ayat) is imported as source texts.

title: Arabic-first RTL interface with language switch
body: Arabic by default, full RTL, Arabic-Indic digits, typed UI dictionary (`lib/i18n.ts`), English and Arabic switch saved in a cookie, Arabic Clerk screens.

title: Arabic UI font for interface text
body:
Pick an Arabic font for buttons, menus and labels (Quran text already uses Amiri Quran).

**Done when:** interface text uses the new font in Arabic mode, and it loads fast on slow connections.

**Current state:** done. In Arabic mode the whole interface uses Noto Naskh Arabic (`font-arabic` on `<body>`, `app/layout.tsx`), self-hosted with `next/font`; Quran text keeps Amiri Quran.

title: RTL check of every exercise screen
body:
Check every screen in `app/lesson/exercises/` in Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR), on mobile, in kids and full mode.

**Done when:** no mirrored icons, wrong alignment or clipped Arabic text remain.

title: Exercise types: order, match, complete, listen, true or false
body: ORDER, MATCH, COMPLETE_WORD, COMPLETE_AYAH, LISTEN and TRUE_FALSE, each with its own screen. Lenient Arabic matching in `lib/arabic.ts`. Audio player with normal and slow replay.

title: Exams per unit and free surah order
body: Every unit ends with an exam, every surah is open, with a "Jump to" picker. A surah is cleared when its exam is passed or all its lessons are done.

title: Kids and full mode with welcome tour
body: Per-device kids or full mode: kids mode has no hearts, shop, leaderboard or quests, and bigger buttons. Welcome tour on the first visit.

title: Read aloud with qari recitation
body:
Each question's instruction is spoken and its ayat recited by a qari (al-Husary muallim for kids, Alafasy otherwise). Never synthesised Quran audio.

**Current state:** ayah audio is served from the QuranicAudio CDN mirror first, with everyayah.com as a fallback and an 8-second stall timeout (#13). Word-by-word audio comes from Quran.com.

title: Repeat-N-times audio for kids who cannot read yet
body:
Let a child hear an ayah 3, 5 or 7 times in a row before answering.

**Done when:** kids mode offers a repeat count, and the count is remembered on the device.

title: Rewards and stickers for kids
body:
Gentle rewards after lessons (stickers, stars), suitable for the honour of the Quran: no gambling-style mechanics.

**Done when:** kids earn a sticker per cleared lesson and can see their collection.

title: Earn hearts back by reviewing mistakes
body:
Hearts never make a learner wait or pay. When they run out, the hearts modal offers a short review of the questions they just got wrong (their 3 latest mistakes, every wrong answer is remembered); each right answer gives a heart back, a wrong one costs nothing, and then they return to their lesson.

**Done when:** merged; running out of hearts mid-lesson leads to a review and back to the same lesson.

Merged in #20.

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/20

title: Read the ayat first, then the questions
body:
Every lesson opens on the ayat it covers (with qari recitation, and the next ayah for "what comes next"), so learners don't guess. Listening questions get a "Can't listen now" button that skips them without points or hearts.

**Done when:** merged and the content re-imported.

Merged in #21, #25 and #33.

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/25

title: Audio for MATCH items and ayah fragments
body:
Recite MATCH items and partial ayat when tapped.

**Done when:** every tappable Quran text in an exercise plays its recitation.

title: Kids lessons: Al-Fatiha and the last 10 surahs
body:
Listen, repeat, order and complete lessons for Al-Fatiha and An-Nas to Al-Fil.

**Done when:** every surah has lessons and an exam, each with its source, ready for scholarly review.

**Status:** built. The "Kids: Short Surahs" course (Arabic and English) has lessons and an exam for every surah, each challenge with its source. Waiting for scholarly review.

title: Spaced-repetition review queue
body:
Bring back ayat a learner is forgetting, at growing intervals.

**Done when:** a daily review lesson is built from the learner's weak ayat.

In review in #37 (daily review with spaced repetition per ayah, and a daily streak).

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/37

title: Daily goal and streak
body:
A small daily goal (e.g. one lesson) and a gentle streak. No guilt messages.

**Done when:** the learn page shows today's goal and the current streak.

In review in #37 (daily review with spaced repetition per ayah, and a daily streak).

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/37

title: Daily wird reminders at a chosen time
body:
Each learner can turn on a daily reminder in Settings and pick the time. It is a web push notification, sent at that time in the device's time zone, and opens the learn page on a "today's wird" card that goes straight to the next lesson.

**Done when:** merged, the push keys and secrets are set (docs/SETUP.md), and a reminder arrives on Android, desktop and an iPhone with Faqih on the Home Screen.

Merged in #19. Still to do outside the code: set the push keys and secrets (docs/SETUP.md) and confirm a reminder arrives on Android, desktop and iPhone.

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/19

title: Stories of the Prophet ﷺ and the Sahabah with quizzes
body: Short stories from sound reports only, each with source and grading recorded, followed by a short quiz. Popular but weak stories are left out.

title: Facts about the Prophet ﷺ for kids
body: Short facts: family, Makkah and Madinah, character. Each fact cites its source.

title: Parent-managed profiles and guest mode
body:
Children never need their own account. Progress is saved on the device and can be merged into a parent account later.

**Done when:** a parent can add child profiles, and a guest can learn without signing up.

title: Scholarly review of every kids lesson and story
body: A qualified reviewer checks every kids lesson and story before it goes live, and lessons move from `draft` to `reviewed`.

title: Decide: age range for the kids path
body:
5 to 10 for now. Confirm with teachers and parents.

**Current state:** the kids course is set to 5 to 10 in code (`minAge`/`maxAge`, `scripts/content/kids.ts`); this only needs confirming.

title: Decide: reciters for kids and adults
body:
For example al-Husary muallim for kids and Alafasy for adults. Check audio licences.

**Current state:** the app already uses al-Husary muallim in kids mode and Alafasy in full mode (`lib/recitation.ts`), from EveryAyah via the QuranicAudio mirror. Confirm the choice and the licences.

title: Decide: riwayah support
body:
Hafs 'an 'Asim by default. Decide whether to support others later.

**Current state:** all text and audio are Hafs 'an 'Asim (Tanzil Uthmani text).

title: Decide: who signs off on content
body: Name the scholars and teachers who review Quran, stories, tajweed and Maher questions.

title: Installable PWA with offline lessons
body: Install to the home screen and keep downloaded lessons usable offline.

title: Accessibility pass: keyboard, screen readers, contrast
body:
Check every screen with a keyboard and a screen reader in Arabic and English.

**Current state:** started: questions are announced to screen readers (`aria-live`), audio and replay buttons have labels, and option cards have number-key shortcuts in full mode. The full pass is still to do.

title: Performance budget for low-end phones
body: Set and meet a size and speed budget on a low-end Android phone over a slow connection.

title: Deploy to free hosting
body:
Cloudflare Workers (recommended) or Vercel Hobby. Keep the bundle small enough for the free plan.

**Current state:** live on Vercel Hobby (faqih-beige.vercel.app) with a Neon Postgres database. Schema changes apply automatically on merge (see "Automatic database schema updates on merge").

title: Automatic database schema updates on merge
body:
A GitHub Action (`.github/workflows/db-push.yml`) runs `drizzle-kit push` when a merge to `main` changes the schema. Changes that could delete data fail on purpose.

**Current state:** done (#8). Needs the `DATABASE_URL` repository secret.

title: Leaderboard shows each learner's current name
body:
The leaderboard read names saved once, when a course was chosen, so people showed as "User" after setting their name. It now reads each listed learner's current name and picture from their account (never the email).

**Done when:** merged and the live leaderboard shows updated names. Pull request: #16.

Merged in #16.

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/16

title: Clear translation and audio licences
body:
Confirm the English translation and audio licences, or switch to openly licensed ones, and add an attribution page.

**Current state:** in use: Sahih International (English meaning), EveryAyah recitations (free with attribution), Quran.com word-by-word audio (licence to confirm), Hisn al-Muslim audio and text. No attribution page yet.

title: Report a correction button and feedback loop
body: Any learner can report a content mistake, and reviewers see and resolve reports.

title: Privacy-respecting analytics and error reporting
body: Minimal data, nothing about children, no third-party ad trackers.

title: Closed beta with 50 to 100 families
body: Invite families from the local community, collect feedback and fix the top issues.

title: The Whole Quran course: 114 units with exams
body: 114 units in mushaf order, a lesson per 5 ayat, and an exam per surah.

title: Richer surah exams: bigger and mixed for full mode, simple for kids
body:
Surah exams grow with the surah (one question per 10 ayat, 10 to 25; Al-Baqarah 26 instead of 8) and spread over the whole surah. Full mode mixes harder, exam-only kinds: type the missing word, which ayah comes before, passages, long word and ayah orderings. Exams use their own wrong answers, different from the lessons'. Kids exams keep to simple kinds they know from lessons, with no typing.

**Done when:** merged and the content re-imported. Merged in #14; run `content:import` to rebuild the exams.

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/14

title: Juz' exams: one exam per juz'
body:
A "Juz' Exams" course for full mode: one 20-question exam per juz', spread across every surah in it, including "which surah is this ayah from?" (never asked for an ayah that appears in more than one surah).

**Done when:** merged and the content re-imported. Merged in #14; run `content:import` to rebuild the exams.

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/14

title: Hifz difficulty levels
body:
Hide 1 word, then several words, then first-letter hints, then the whole ayah.

**Current state:** full-mode exams already include one recall step: type a missing word with no options.

title: On-screen Arabic keyboard for typed answers
body:
Learners without an Arabic keyboard can still type answers. Matching ignores diacritics and letter variants.

**Current state:** lenient matching is done (`lib/arabic.ts`: no diacritics, Uthmani or everyday spelling); typed answers are used in full-mode exams. The on-screen keyboard is still to do.

title: Surah recitation player
body: Play a surah ayah by ayah, with repeat and slow replay.

title: Hifz review queue across the whole Quran
body: A revision plan for everything a learner has memorised.

title: Meaning of each ayah for non-Arabic speakers
body:
Show the meaning of each ayah in the learner's language, from a licensed, reviewed translation.

**Current state:** English courses already use the meaning (Sahih International) for kids, the Whole Quran and Al-Fatiha. Showing the meaning next to the Arabic is still to do.

Merged in #26: English mode shows the Quran in Arabic with the meaning under each ayah. Licensing of the translation is tracked in "Clear translation and audio licences".

Pull request: https://github.com/aliabusaleh/faqih/pull/26

title: Opt-in leaderboard and themed quests
body:
Quests like "complete Juz Amma". Leaderboards are always opt-in.

**Current state:** a leaderboard and points quests exist (from the original app), hidden in kids mode, but not opt-in yet.

title: Colour-coded tajweed text
body: Show tajweed rules in colour. Check the licence of the tajweed data source first.

title: Tajweed rule explanations with audio examples
body: Noon sakinah and tanween, meem sakinah, madd, qalqalah and more, each with recited examples.

title: Tajweed exercises
body: Spot the rule in an ayah, listen and pick the rule, and match rules to examples.

title: Tajweed review by qualified teachers
body: Every tajweed lesson is checked by a teacher qualified in tajweed before it goes live.

title: Maher mode: design and adab rules
body:
Named after the hadith "The one who is skilled (الماهر) in the Quran will be with the noble, righteous scribes" (Bukhari & Muslim).

Design the challenge mode: question types, scoring that rewards mastery and not speed alone, and adab rules (sourced questions, no altered Quran text, reviewed before publishing).

title: Maher: Quran challenges
body: Continue the ayah, name the surah, find the ayah number, which juz is this in, timed revision runs.

title: Maher: Islamic knowledge question bank
body: Sirah, the Prophets, the Sahabah, adhkar, pillars of Islam and iman, Quranic vocabulary. Every question cites its source.

title: Maher: levels and badges
body: Levels that reward mastery, and badges for milestones like finishing a juz.

title: Maher: opt-in challenges with family and friends
body: Friendly, opt-in challenges between people who know each other. No public ranking by default.

title: Maher: scholarly review of the question bank
body: Every Maher question is reviewed before it goes live.

title: More UI languages: Urdu, Indonesian, Turkish, French
body: Extend `lib/i18n.ts` and add reviewed translations of the Quran's meaning.

title: Recitation feedback with speech recognition
body: Research spike first: can we give reliable feedback on a learner's recitation?

title: Hadith path beyond an-Nawawi 1 to 10
body: Grow the draft an-Nawawi course into a full hadith path.

title: Sirah path: Makkan and Madinan periods
body: Sirah beyond the kids' stories, with timelines.

title: Quranic Arabic vocabulary
body: Learn the most frequent words of the Quran.

title: Faqih level: fiqh
body: Fiqh rulings, mahr and inheritance (needs a rules engine), and a policy on madhhab.

title: Native app wrapper
body: Capacitor or Expo.

title: Content CMS for reviewers
body: Reviewers edit and approve content without touching code.

title: Read mode: the whole Quran one juz' at a time
body:
A Read page to read the whole Quran, one juz' at a time, alongside the lessons.
